violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the walk-in cooler outside, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
The floors under the front refrigeration/freezer units were observed with food debris. The floors must be cleaned as often as necessary. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Dry foods and single service items were observed stored on the floor in the dry storage area. Food and single service items must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/08/2024
